proposedContributions.change: Define a provider-neutral CodeIntelligenceToolRuntime with repoStatus/search/readSpan/architectureRead/wikiSearch/wikiRead/plan/propose capabilities using dependency-owned DTOs. Keep only a registration/transport seam, no second source/job/proposal store. Each method accepts host-derived session authority; resolve current scope/lease/freshness before releasing data, including cached data. Distinguish absent transport from unsupported provider. Register a host adapter in-process; install an authenticated RPC adapter in subprocess when available, otherwise return a typed unavailable error. Do not expose automatic apply or execute generation from plan.

Implement code_search and repo_status through the runtime; also house repo_wiki_search if needed to cover the normative read suite without inventing a new owned file. Validate raw arguments as well as canonical schemas, clamp request and response bounds, preserve skipped/truncated and source refs. Delegate local retrieval/argv execution to CI-003 rather than add an index or shell runner.

Implement code_read accepting scoped FileSpan/ref, architecture_read and repo_wiki_read through the shared runtime. No arbitrary filesystem paths. Resolve captured exact ranges plus current policy and hash/freshness; return contentHash, snapshot/sourceVersion, stale/missing and evidence/trust. Preserve graph kind and unsupported edge limitations, and complete selected wiki sections under the CI-006 bounded-section contract. Never silently cut a wiki section to fit the generic knowledge body cap.

Implement intelligence_plan and artifact_propose as stage-only calls. Return run plan/file manifest/data exposure/budget or pending ReviewProposal with artifact/baseHash/affectedFiles and review/run refs. Validate managed namespace/ownership and current actor policy; no runtime.run/apply call in a stage handler. Do not confuse handler filename intelligence-propose with the normative wire name artifact_propose. Writer job intelligence_run and navigator artifact_apply remain separate authorized boundaries, not implicit side effects.

Add deterministic consumer-visible tests using dependency-backed fixture snapshots for foreign scope, exclusion/symlink traversal, forged ref/hash, current policy change, stale/missing source, bounded results, complete wiki sections, graph kind/trust preservation, absent subprocess transport and stage-only effects. Check real proposal persistence remains pending and managed/source file hashes unchanged. Exercise denied writer/apply calls and injected repository instructions, not just schema membership/mock forwarding. Native transport and UI verification remain separate required lanes.
